name: Candlelight: Coldplay & Imagine Dragons
description: A candlelit tribute concert of music by Coldplay and Imagine Dragons at Palácio da Bolsa on Saturday 12 December at 19:30. Tickets from €19.50.
longDescription:
Candlelight concerts present live music in a space lit by a sea of candles. This one is a tribute to Coldplay and Imagine Dragons, played by a string quartet that has not been announced yet. It is a tribute concert and has no affiliation with or endorsement from the artists or their representatives.

The planned programme includes Clocks, Fix You, The Scientist, Viva La Vida and Sky Full of Stars by Coldplay, and Radioactive, Thunder, Bad Liar and Believer by Imagine Dragons. The concert lasts 60 minutes. Doors open 60 minutes before the start, and no one is let in after the doors close. It is for ages 6 and up, and under-16s must come with an adult. Seats are given out on arrival, first come first served, based on ticket type.

The concert is at Palácio da Bolsa on Saturday 12 December 2026 at 19:30. The venue is wheelchair accessible. Tickets from €19.50.
